0.en: 5. Speech at the close of the school year on 2 September 1813105)
0.zh: 5. 1813 年 9 月 2 日学年结束演辞105)

en: The end of a year of study calls for it in itself, and the highest orders have arranged that at such a close one should cast a retrospective glance at what has been done and has taken place in the course of the year, and consider the results of the year's efforts.

The course of the years is for the institution mere duration, for the teachers a constantly recurring cycle of their business; but for the pupils above all a progressive course which raises them every year onto a new stage. - Since the annual report that appears in print contains what can be reckoned towards the history of our institution in the past year, little needs to be said here.
zh: 一个学习年度的结束本身就会召唤人去做这件事，而至高的命令也已作出安排：在这样一个结束之际，应当回望这一年中所做所行之事，并考察这一年度努力的结果。
岁月的流转对于机构而言不过是延续，对于教师而言是自身事务一再重复的循环；但对于学生，尤其是把他们每年都提升到新台阶上的一段进程。——既然付印的年度报告已包含可算作我们机构过去一年历史的那一切，这里便只需不多的话了。

en: For an institution it is in any case the greatest good fortune when it has no history, when it merely has duration.
The better kills the good is a meaningful proverb; it expresses that the striving after the better, when it becomes a craving, does not let the good come into being, does not let it come to ripeness.
If the ordinances and institutions which are meant to constitute the firm ground and support for what is changeable are themselves made changeable, on what should the changeable in itself hold?
General institutions too are indeed in process of development, but this development is slow; a single year counts little in it; changes in them are marked by great and rare epochs.
If a government claims the gratitude of its subjects for improvements, then these too must be visibly for the preservation of the appropriate institutions which are once in operation.
Our institution too has thus had no history in the past year; the well-known arrangement of it, disregarding more precise determinations in some formalities, has remained the same.
zh: 对一所机构来说，最大的幸运本就是它没有历史，只有延续。
「更好的杀死好的」是一句有意味的谚语；它表明：追求更好的努力一旦变成贪欲，就不能让好的东西得以生成，不能让它成熟。
如果那些本应为可变之物提供坚定根基与支撑的法则与制度本身也变得可变，那么那本质上可变的东西又该倚靠什么呢？
一般性的制度固然也处在不断推进之中，但这种推进是缓慢的；单独一年在这件事上无关紧要；它们的变化是以宏大而罕见的时代为标志的。
如果一个政府要以臣民因改进而生的感激来为自己增光，那么这些改进同样必须明显地是为了维持那些既已在运转的合宜制度。
因此，我们机构在过去一年同样没有历史；除去某些形式细节上的更具体规定之外，它那众所周知的设置仍旧如故。

en: In the history of the teaching staff the painful loss is to be recorded which we have suffered through the death of the collaborator-teacher Link, a very deserving teacher who with zeal and activity presided over his office, to which his pupils clung with love; only a few days ago they paid him the tears of their attachment at his grave.
Yet the young stride forward; in them the feeling of the growth of life outweighs the feeling of loss, and the older relatives and friends chiefly feel the irrecoverable in the loss of a dear man.
zh: 在教师队伍的历程中，应当记下我们因协作班教师林克之死而遭受的痛苦损失——他是一位十分尽职的教师，以热忱与勤勉主持自己的职务，他的学生怀着爱戴之情依恋着他；几天之前，他们才在他的墓前献上依恋的泪水。
然而青年是在不断前进的；在他们身上，生命成长的感觉压过了失落的感觉，而年长的亲属与朋友则尤其感受到失去一位挚爱的人这件事的不可挽回。

en: Since youth is above all the time of moving forward, a completed year of study is for them above all an important new stage.
Those who have made themselves capable of it pass over into a new class, into a higher occupation and to other teachers.
This is a general reward which they must earn by attention and diligence, and I dwell for a few moments on this point.

For in the advance to further classes it is not the case that the pupils after the lapse of a certain time inevitably move up into a higher division, be they ever so well-behaved, and whether they have made progress or not.

The teachers, if they only thought of themselves, would gladly see themselves rid of those with whose inattention, lack of diligence and other improper conduct they have already had to struggle for a year.

But higher considerations lay on them here the duty of making promotion solely on the ground of worth, against what would be more agreeable to them, against the expectations of the pupils and perhaps also of the parents.
Those who want to study dedicate themselves preferably to the service of the state.

The public institutions of study are above all plant-schools for state servants; they owe it to the government to supply it with none but serviceable men, just as they owe it to the parents not to raise groundless hopes, which would in any case be disappointed in the sequel and would entail only wasted expense and the neglect of a more appropriate education.
zh: 由于青年时代主要是向前行进的时期，所以一个已完成的学习年度，对他们来说首先就是一个重要的新台阶。
那些使自己具备这种能力的人，便升入新的班级、接受更高一层的学习任务，并转到别的教师之下。
这是他们必须以专注与勤勉赢得的一种普遍奖赏，我在此点上稍作停留。
因为在向更高班级推进时，事情并不是这样：学生经过一定时间后必定升入更高的班级——无论他们表现得怎样，也无论他们是否取得了进步。
教师们如果只替自己着想，就会乐于摆脱那些学生——一年来他们不得不与这些人的不用心、不勤勉以及别的不得体的举止相周旋。
但更高的考量在此把一项义务加在他们身上：不顺着自己所更为愿意的，不顺着学生乃至也许还有家长的期待，只按照是否相称来决定晋升。
那些想要读书的人，优先地献身于国家公务。
公立学校主要是国家公务人员的苗圃；它们有责任为政府输送得用的人，正如它们有责任不给父母造成无根据的希望——这些希望无论如何都会在后来落空，只会招致徒然的花费和对更合宜的教养的耽误。

en: For the parents it would indeed be the greatest contradiction if on the one hand they wished - and they certainly do wish it - that they should have worthy clergymen as spiritual advisers and preachers, that right should be spoken to them by the insightful and the fair-minded, that they should find skilled physicians for the care of their bodily condition, that their public welfare in general should be in the hands of sensible and unassuming men, - and if on the other hand they demanded that their awkward sons should be brought into such offices and occupations and should later on be admitted to them as well.
zh: 对家长来说，一方面他们希望——他们当然希望——自己拥有配得上的教士作为牧者和讲道者，有见识而通晓事理的人替他们主持公道，为照料他们身体状况能找到高明的医生，他们公共的福利总之掌握在明智而平实的人手中——而另一方面却又要求他们笨拙的儿子被送进这类职务和事务、并且日后也被准许担任这些职务，这将是最大的自相矛盾。

en: This higher goal is already to be seen in the state institutions which are one of the preparatory stages to that destination; the arbitrariness of the heads of study and the teachers just as much as that of the parents places itself on the side of this higher destination.
zh: 这一更高的目标在那些作为通向那一志向的诸准备阶段之一的国家学校里已经可以看见了；学习主持者与教师的任意，正如父母方面的任意一样，都站到了这一更高志向的一边。

en: But immediately too an unconditional advance into a higher class without the capability appropriate to that class would be far more harmful to the pupils themselves.
It is not difficult to see that it happens entirely to their own benefit if, in accordance with their qualification, they are held back in a class longer than it could otherwise happen.

For being incapable of higher instruction and entering on it without the requisite foundation, it would be for them for the most part lost; they would only keep going further back instead of forward, whereas they can really take part in the instruction of the lower stage and will make progress through this participation. - At the same time it is more decent and more encouraging for them to be given the opportunity to rise into higher places among new fellow-pupils than to be left among the former ones, who are once ahead of them and among whom they would have to stand back forever, which would be depressing for them. - This holding back in the same class be a spur to them to take their studies more to heart and to reward the hopes of their parents and the efforts of their teachers better.
zh: 但若不在相应地具备该级别所要求的能力，就立即升入更高的班级，这对学生自己反而更为不利。
不难看出：如果他们依其资格而被留在一个班级里，比之原本可能的情形待得更久一些，这完全是出于他们自身的利益。

因为对更高一级的教学既不能承受、又在欠缺应有基础的情况下去承受，对他们来说大半是徒然；他们只会越来越多地后退而不是前进；相反，他们能够真正参与较低一级阶段的教学，并且会通过这种参与而取得进步。——同时，为他们提供机会让他们在新同学之中向上攀到更高的位置，比之把他们留在那些一旦就走在他们前面的旧同学之中、使得他们必须永远落在后面，对他们而言既更体面也更鼓舞人心。——这种在同一班级里的滞留应当成为对他们的鞭策，使他们更认真地对待自己的学业，更好地回报父母的期望和教师的努力。

en: In several classes, however, it is in any case established by rule that one stays two years; it is a special distinction to be promoted after a single year, and remaining there a year longer is not yet a setback.
zh: 不过在好几个班级里，本来就有规定要待上两年；一年之后即获提升乃是一种特殊的优待，而多留一年还不算是降级。

en: The most important stage has been reached by those for whom the past year of study was the last of their stay at the gymnasium and who now go on to the university for their nearer destination.
In the new sphere into which you, gentlemen, are entering, you will experience what fruits a well-used gymnasium instruction bears.

I may give you the public testimony that you have on the whole applied your time diligently, and that you have also of your own initiative attacked and grasped the subjects of instruction, so that your teachers exercised the teaching profession not only because of their office but gladly for the sake of your application. - The skills and knowledge which you have acquired at the gymnasium, the circle of subjects with which you have occupied yourself, are means for your future science of a profession; but I may believe that an interest in these subjects, as they deserve, has also been founded in you in itself.
zh: 最重要的阶段已经由这样一些人达到：过去这个学习年度就是他们留在文科中学的最后一年，如今他们为更切近的志向而前往大学。
在各位先生即将踏入的那个新领域里，你们将体验到一份用得好的文科中学教学结出怎样的果实。
我可以向你们出具公开的证明：总的来说你们勤勉地使用了你们的时间，并且还出于自己的主动性去钻研并掌握各个教学科目，因此你们的教师不只是出于职务的缘故、而且也乐意出于对你们勤勉的喜爱而从事教学工作。——你们在文科中学所获得的技能与知识，你们所钻研的那些科目所构成的圈子，是你们未来本行学问的手段；但我可以相信，对这些课题本身——就其所应得而言——的兴趣也已在你们心中建立起来。

en: I will still indicate briefly this relation between the gymnasium studies and the science of one's profession.

In the study of the ancients, the distinguished subject of the gymnasium studies, the beginnings and fundamental notions of the sciences or of what is worth knowing in general are found, and hence they are so well suited to the preparation for the professional sciences; and with respect to the fine arts they are the completion. - In general they have the peculiarity that in them the abstract reflections still show themselves in the neighbourhood of the concrete, that the concept forms itself out of the example; the (representations of) human things according to their actuality make up the ground, which at the same time presents itself along with the general result.

The abstract thought has therefore a living freshness; we receive it in its naivety, joined to the personal sensation and to the individuality of the circumstances out of which it arises; it has therefore its peculiar clarity and intelligibility.
zh: 我还要用几句话略示文科中学的学习与本行学问之间的这一关系。
在对古代人的研究——文科中学学习中最杰出的对象——中，可以找到诸门科学乃至一切值得认知之物的开端与基本表象；因此它们如此适于为诸般职业学问作准备；而就美的艺术而言，它们就是其完成。——总的说来，它们有一项特性：抽象的反思在其中仍显现于具体之物的近旁，概念由范例中形成出来；按照其现实性的（关于人的事物的）表象构成其根基，而这根基同时与一般的结果一道呈现。
因此，抽象的思想具有活泼的新鲜感；我们在其天真中接受它，它与个人的感受以及它所由产生的那种情势的个别性联结在一起；因此它具有自己特有的清楚与易懂。

en: As the form has this completeness of the concrete, so too the content, and indeed it concerns human life in general and above all public life.

What, according to the constitution of modern times, has been removed from our contemplation and our participation - the passions, the deeds and efforts of peoples, the great relations which constitute the cohesion of the civil and moral order, upon which the life of states, the condition, (the interest) and the activity of individuals rest - are brought before our eyes vividly.

The classical age stands in the beautiful middle between the rugged substantiality of a nation in its unconscious childhood and the refined understanding of cultivation, which has analysed everything and holds it apart.

In this latter state the intimate life of the whole has stepped out of the mind of the individuals as an abstract spirit; each individual receives only a fragmented, remote share in it, is allotted a restricted sphere, over which is the soul which calculates all these wheels and particular movements and leads them to unity; they do not have the feeling and the active representation of the whole.
zh: 正如形式具有这种具体之物的完整性一样，内容也具有；而且内容所涉及的正是人类生活的一般情形，尤其是公共生活。
依新时代的制度已从我们的观照与参与中移开的东西——各民族的激情、行动与努力，那些构成市民的与道德的秩序之凝聚的重大关系，各国的生活、个人的状况、（利益）与活动都建立其上——都被生动地呈现在我们眼前。
古典时代处在两种状态之间美好的中间位置上：一端是一个民族在无意识的童年时代那种粗犷的坚实，另一端是教养所达到的精致知性——这种知性把一切都分析过，并且把一切分门别类地保留下来。
在这后一种状态中，整体的内在生命已作为抽象的精神从诸个人的心中脱离开来；每个人只分得其中零碎的、疏远的一份，被分派到一个有限的领域，在它之上是那个计算着这一切齿轮与特殊运动、并把它们引向统一的灵魂；他们没有对整体的感觉，也没有对整体的能动表象。

en: In that we dedicate ourselves at all to a particular profession, we place ourselves at a post severed from the presence of the whole, we assign ourselves to a limited part.
The ideals of youth are a boundless; one calls reality a sad thing because it does not correspond to that infinite.
But active life, efficacy, character has this essential condition, that it fix itself on a particular point; whoever wants to do something great, says the poet, must be able to limit himself.

The station, however, to which we in our time devote ourselves, is more exclusive than it was among the ancients; we lose the life of the whole in a more extended sense than was the case with them in a definite profession.

So much the more important is it for us, since we are men, since we are rational beings founded on the ground of the infinite and the ideal, to create and to preserve in ourselves the representation and the concept of a complete life.

Into this representation the studia humaniora above all introduce us; they give the intimate representation of the human whole; the manner and way of the freedom of the old states, the intimate connection of public and private life, of the general sense and the private disposition, brings it about that the great interests of individual humanity, the most important pillars of public and private activity, the powers which overthrow and raise peoples, present themselves as thoughts of an intercourse that is constant, as simple natural contemplations of everyday objects of an ordinary present - thoughts which in our education do not enter into the circle of our life and doing - so that laws and duties too show themselves to us in a living form, as customs and virtues, not in the form of reflections and principles by which we regulate ourselves as by remote and imposed prescriptions.
zh: 然而我们一旦献身于某一特定职业，就把自己安置在与整体的直接在场相分离的位置上，把自己归入某个有限的部分。
青年的理想是一种无边无际的东西；人们之所以称这现实性为可悲的，就在于它与那种无限不相符合。
但实践的生活、事功与性格有这样一个本质条件：把自己固定在某个确定的点上；凡想成就伟大之事者，诗人说，必须能够约束自己。
然而我们这个时代所献身的地位，比古人那里更为排他；我们在一种更为扩展的意义上失去了整体的生活，而在古人那里这只发生在某一确定职业之中。
这对我们就更为重要，因为我们是人，因为我们是建立在无限与理想之根据上的有理性的存在者，我们要在自身之中创造并保持一个完整生活的表象与概念。

尤其正是人文诸科（studia humaniora）把我们引入这一表象之中；它们给出关于人的整体的亲密表象；古时各邦自由的方式与形态、公共生活与私人生活的紧密联结、普遍见识与私人心态的联结，都带来了这样的结果：个体人性的重大利益、公共与私人活动最重要的支柱、那些倾覆与抬升各民族的力量，都呈现为持续往来的思想，呈现为对一个平常当下之日常对象的单纯自然观照——这些思想在我们的教养中并不进入我们生活与行动的圈子——因此，法则与义务也对我们以活生生的形式、作为风俗与美德显现出来，而不是以反思与准则的形式，在这种形式下我们把自己当作依据疏远的、外加的规定来遵循。

en: At the university the further separation, the nearer determination to a particular profession, begins; so, gentlemen, do not forget there the gymnasium studies, partly on account of their usefulness as a means, partly also in order to keep permanently present the fundamental notion of a noble life and to secure for yourselves an inner, more beautiful place, into which you will gladly return from the isolation of actual life, but out of which you will also emerge, without the dullness of longing, without the inactive impotence of enthusiasm, rather strengthened and refreshed for your destination and the efficacy entrusted to you.
zh: 在大学里，更进一步的分离——即对某一特定职业的更切近的定性——开始了；因此，各位先生，请不要在那里忘记文科中学的学习：一部分是因为它们作为手段的效用，另一部分也是为了使一个高贵生活的基本表象始终保持在眼前，并为自己巩固一个内在的、更美的地方；你们会乐于从现实生活的个别化中回到那里，而你们从那里走出来时，也不是带着思念的沉闷、不是带着沉醉那种无所作为的无力，毋宁说是被加强和提振起来，去承担你们的使命与所受委的职守。

en: Finally, however, we pass over to the nearer and proper purpose of this assembly, to the distribution of the prizes to those who distinguished themselves especially in the past year, in so far as the prescribed number of prizes allows us to reward them in this way.

Also in these prizes and in this ceremony we recognise the care and the attention of the royal government with which it regards the instruction of the young and in every way animates and promotes their progress.

The importance of a good education is never felt more strongly than under the circumstances of our times, in which all external possession, however well acquired and legitimate, must so often be considered as precarious and the safest as doubtful; the inner treasures which parents give their children through a good education and through the use of the schools are imperishable and retain their value under all circumstances; it is the best and safest good that they can provide for their children and leave behind.
zh: 最后，我们转向这次集会更切近、更专门的用意，即向在过去一年中特别出众的人分发奖品——就规定数目的奖品允许我们以此方式奖赏他们而言。
同样，在这些奖品和这场庆典中，我们也认出王室政府的那种精心与专注：它以这种态度关注青年们的教学，并以一切方式使他们的进步生动活泼并加以促进。
在我们时代的处境下——在这种处境中，一切外在的占有，无论它获得得多么妥帖、合法，都必须如此频繁地被看作摇摆不定，而最可靠的也被看作可疑——良好教育的重要性从没有比这更被强烈地感受到；父母通过良好的教育、通过对学校的利用而给予子女的内在财富是不可毁灭的，在一切情形下都保持其价值；这是他们能为子女备下并留下的最好、最可靠的财富。

en: For this youth, which is not yet capable of recognising the importance of the task it undertakes and of the acquisition it makes in knowledge and formation in its true worth, may the rewards now to be bestowed and this solemn distinction serve as an encouragement to diligence; in these signs of the satisfaction of their teachers and their board, which they have the good fortune to receive from the gracious hand of the royal lord general commissariat, the reward of their well-spent precious years of youth already begins, as also the reward of their parents for the toil and care which these expended on them, - a first reward which in the course of their life may and shall bear ever greater and richer fruits.
zh: 对于这批青年——他们尚不能真正认识到自己所从事之事的重要性，也尚不能真正认识到自己在知识与教养上所取得之收获的价值——现在所要给予的奖赏和这一隆重的表彰，就应当成为对勤勉的鼓励；在这些他们有幸从皇家总务署阁下的恩赐之手中领受的、表示其教师与校务委员会满意之情的标志中，他们那段好好度过的宝贵青年时代的报偿便已开始，而他们父母在他们身上所付出的辛劳与关心的报偿也便已开始——这是一初的报偿，愿它在他们一生的进程中不断结出更大、更丰饶的果实，也必将结出这样的果实。

16.en: 6. Speech at the close of the school year on 30 August 1815106)
16.zh: 6. 1815 年 8 月 30 日学年结束演辞106)

en: We gather here again today to close the completed year of study in a solemn manner, above all in that those gymnasium pupils who have made themselves worthy of it through diligence, progress and good conduct receive a public distinction.

If this act, in relation to the institution itself, is every year an identical repetition, yet with respect to the young men, whose formation is the purpose of the institute, and for the parents, whose dearest hopes and also anxieties are united in them, it shows renewal and rejuvenation, progress and conclusion.
zh: 我们今天再次聚集于此，以庄重的方式为这个已完成的学习年度作结，主要是让那些以勤勉、进步和良好品行而配得上这一荣誉的文科中学学生获得公开表彰。
这一仪式就机构本身而言每年都是同样的一次重复，但就少年们——他们的教养是本校的宗旨——以及就家长们——他们最亲爱的希望与忧虑都汇合在少年们身上——而言，它却显示出更新与年轻化、进步与终结。

en: What was carried on and accomplished in the past year of study at the various class levels, of this picture uniform as a whole and continuous with the preceding years, the printed annual report gives an account in accordance with the regulations.

If in other times we regard this uniformity of the course of existing institutions as something merely ordinary that calls for no remark, we may yet in the last elapsed and present fateful period, in which we ourselves see here the preparations for war (and for revolution), leave unheeded the favour that disturbances or pressure, or what is even harder, which have befallen other lands, have remained quite far away from our state and thus also from its schools; that the distress of the time, which elsewhere has laid claim to the whole rising nation and among it also to the part which devotes itself to the sciences and the peaceful purposes of the state, has not touched our young men in this respect, but rather (all who would also have had the age and the strength for that calling) that it has been permitted to them to advance calmly on their course.
zh: 过去这个学习年度在各个班级阶段上所进行和所完成的事情，关于这幅与前几年连成一气、整体上均质的图景，付印的年度报告已依规定作出了说明。

如果在其他时候，我们把这种既有制度运行上的均一性看作某种只是寻常的、不值得一述的东西，那么在刚刚过去的和当前这个命运多舛的时期里——在这个时期，我们在这附近就亲眼看到备战（和颠覆的准备）——我们却不能不顾这一恩惠：那些落到别国头上的干扰与压迫、乃至更为严酷的事，恰恰离我们的国家、因而也离它的学校还很遥远；时代的困苦——它在别处把整个正在兴起的民族、其中也包括献身于学术与和平的国家宗旨的那一部分征用于战争——却没有从这一方面触及我们的少年；毋宁说（那些本来年龄与体力都足以担起那种使命的人）他们获准在自己的道路上从容前行。

en: Only of one change which has entered into the arrangement of our institution in the past year do I have to give a brief account, in order to make the parents attentive to it with a view to the intention of letting their children run through the path of the gymnasium studies.

Up to this last year we had a preparatory class under the name of the collaborator class, which preceded entry into the proper first stage of formation, which according to the normal type begins with the lower-first class.

Because that collaborator class wavered between preparation and that formally first stage, and because the prescribed two-year courses in the lower- and upper-first class were not kept to regularly, it happened that the uniform and long-continued practice of the elementary knowledge did not take place to the extent intended through the repetition of one and the same course with the same teacher.
The two primary classes receive through the now normal arrangement a firmer character, and the succession of stages has thereby gained in determinateness.

For those wishing to enter the lowest class, however, the demand of what they are to bring with them in knowledge has now been raised to some degree; it has now been made a condition that those to be admitted are practised in the technical part, at least in the Latin declensions and conjugations.

The advantage which arises for the institution and for the progress of its pupils from this greater preparation brought along can only be brought about if this condition is strictly observed on admission, so as not to bring a disproportion into the whole arrangement.

The parents have to arrange by private enterprise that their children to be admitted acquire, besides fluent reading and writing in German and Latin, the necessary firmness in the specified knowledge.

It is true that such an initially mechanical learning has more the nature of private instruction, since each individual has to learn these elements for himself and each has to be examined individually, whereby so much time is taken up in public instruction that must for the most part flow away unoccupied and uselessly for the rest.

However much spirit one may wish to bring into the learning of the elementary knowledge, the beginning must always take place in a mechanical way; so far we have not yet got as far as that in machines so inventive England, where one teacher in a school looks after 1000 children, who receive instruction themselves in divisions of pupils and who, like a number of rows of oars, learn all at once in regular stroke-beat.

However this first mechanical ground may be laid, the next following stage of instruction consists in the acquisition of an intelligent and freer firmness and skill in application; the guidance to this is then indisputably capable of common participation and can in any case retain the character of public instruction.
zh: 对于过去一年在我们机构的设置中所发生的一处变更，我只需作简短的说明，好让家长们在打算让孩子走完文科中学学习之路这件事上留意到它。
直到去年为止，我们设有一个称作协作班的准备班，它先于学生进入真正的第一教养阶段，而这一阶段按通常的类型是从初级最低班开始的。
由于那个协作班在准备阶段与那个正式的第一阶段之间摇摆不定，又由于规定在初级最低班与初级最高班中的两年课程未能按常规完成，结果是：基础知识的统一而持久的操练，没有达到通过由同一位教师重复同一门课程所要达到的程度。
两个初级班通过如今这正规的组织获得了更坚实的性质，阶段的先后次序也因而更具规定性。
不过，对于想要进入最低班的学生，他们应当带来的知识方面的要求如今提高了一些；现在已把这样一条列为条件：被录取者须在技术性（机械）操作上，至少在拉丁语的变格与变位上已有操练。
机构及其学生之进步从这份随身带来的更充分准备中所得的益处，只有在录取时严格守住这一条件才可能实现，以免使整个设置出现失衡。
家长须通过私人安排，使将被录取的孩子除了具备流利的德语与拉丁语读写之外，还获得在上述知识上的必要扎实程度。
这是真的：这种起初属于机械性质的学习更带有私人授课的性质，因为每个人都得自己学这些要素，而且每个人都得单独受考查；这样在公共教学中就占去了许多时间，而这些时间对其余的人来说大多只能无所事事地、徒然流掉。
无论人们多么想把精神灌注进基础知识的习得之中，开端总归只能以机械的方式进行；在这方面，我们眼下还没有做到像在机器方面如此富于发明力的英国那样：那里一位教师在一所学校里照看一千名儿童，他们分成若干学生小组自行受教，并且像一排排划桨的长凳那样，按着有节奏的桨拍同时一起学习。
无论这最初机械的基础以何种方式铺就，接下来的教学阶段都在于获得一种通晓的、更自由的扎实程度以及运用的熟练；对这一点的指导则无疑是可以共同参与的，并且在任何情况下都能保持公共教学的性质。

en: For the parents, however, it may always remain desirable that a public opportunity also be found for that particular purpose of preparation, even if it is somewhat imperfect by its nature.

If it can be hoped that this wish will be fulfilled in time, then at present there are still by far more general and important needs of the education of youth, whose satisfaction must first have advanced further still, in order also to do justice to more special wishes. - The further preparation which, besides the mentioned elements of Latin, is likewise required for admission to the grammar school, chiefly namely fluent reading and writing in German, is left to the instruction of the general elementary schools.
Not only does this preparation contain much more than those Latin elements, but it is of general importance for the whole numerous youth who are not destined for scientific study.
zh: 不过，对家长来说，始终值得期望的是：连这一特别的准备目的也能有一种公共的机会——尽管按其本性它总归有些不完善。
如果可以希望这一愿望日后能够实现，那么眼下摆在我们面前的，还有远为普遍和重要的青年教养方面的需要，而这些需要的满足必须先进一步推进，才能照顾到那些更为特殊的愿望。——除了所提到的拉丁语要素之外，为进入文科中学同样必需的那份进一步的准备——主要就是流利的德语读写——则留给了普通公立小学的教学去承担。
这份准备所包含的远不止那些拉丁语要素；而且对于那整个为数众多、并非注定要从事学术研究的大批青年来说，它具有普遍的重要性。

en: I seize this public occasion to touch upon the fact that on this side much is still to be desired and to be done, and that the infirmities from which the elementary schools here still suffer are incurable without an essential transformation.

An orderly progression through the stages and the separation of unequal pupils into separate classes under their own teachers, as well as on the other hand the independence of the teachers' instruction from the arbitrariness and inclination of the parents, are requirements which are indispensably necessary for the flourishing of public educational institutions.

The opposed defects, the bringing together in one school under one teacher of children of different levels of knowledge, combined with the arbitrariness of the parents with regard to school attendance in general and its regularity, do not improve of themselves so long as the schools are private institutions.

The history indeed of most institutions of the state begins with the fact that a need felt more generally was first provided for by private persons and private undertakings and occasional donations, as was the case with poor relief, medical help, yes even in many respects with regard to divine service and the administration of justice, and still is from time to time in part.

But if the common life of men in general becomes more manifold and the entanglements of civilisation greater, then the disjointed and inadequate character of such isolated arrangements shows itself more and more; likewise, since the good has become a general habit and usage, that private arbitrariness has reserved for itself only misuse or neglect, so that only these are still to be taken away from free caprice.

As much on the one hand a limit must remain sacred within which the state government must not touch the private life of the citizens, so much must it take up those objects which are more closely connected with the purpose of the state and subject them to a systematic regulation.

There enters a moment in which such objects have ripened so far through private enterprise and the remaining connection of circumstances that they on the one hand give themselves out as a general need, on the other hand have become so cunning in themselves that the individual concerned can no longer undertake the investigation of what is provided for him and how it is provided, nor does he still have the means in hand to undertake the arrangement for himself alone according to his insight, but is therein dependent on the usage and the private arbitrariness. - Institutions in which the survey of the whole lies at the foundation, and from which the separation and the securing of the various stages must proceed, we have to expect from the care of the government.
zh: 我借此公开的机会谈一谈：从这一面看，还有许多事情需要期望、也需要去做；而本地公立小学至今所患的那些弊病，若不作实质性的改造，是无从医治的。
有秩序的阶段推进、把程度不齐的学生分入由各自教师任教的班级，以及另一方面教师的教学不受父母任意与偏好左右，这些是公共学校兴盛所不可缺少的要求。
与此相反的那些弊病——把知识水平不同的孩子置于同一所学校、同一教师之下——再加上父母在是否上学以及上学的规律性方面的任意，只要学校还是私人机构，就不会自行改善。
大多数国家机构的历史确实是从这样开始的：一个更为普遍地感受到的需要，最初是由私人、私人经营以及偶然的捐赠来供给的——正如在济贫、医疗救助方面，甚至在礼拜与司法方面许多场合所曾是并且不时至今仍是如此。
然而，当人们的共同生活总体上变得更为多样、文明的纠葛变得更大时，这类孤立安排的互不连贯与不足之处就愈发显现；同样，既然好的做法已经成为一种普遍的习常与惯例，私人任意就只给自己留下了滥用或疏忽这两件事，以致如今只有这些还须从恣意中收回来。
一方面必须守住一条神圣的界限，国家政府在这界限之内不得触碰公民的私人生活；另一方面，它也必须把那些与国家宗旨联系更为紧密的对象接管过来，使它们服从有计划的规制。

会出现这样一个时刻：这类对象经由私人的努力以及各种关系之间的其余联系而如此成熟，以至于它们一方面显示为一种普遍的需要，另一方面在自身内部又变得如此精巧，以致涉身其中的个人已不能再承担对「自己得到什么、以及自己如何得到它」的考察，也不再握有按照自己的见识独自去筹办此事的手段，毋宁说他在其中已经依赖于那种惯例与私人的任意。——那些以对整体的概观为基础、并由此必须分出并确定各个不同阶段的机构，我们只能指望政府的筹划去建立。

en: What has been achieved and ordered for the education of youth in more recent times and through the care of our most gracious government is indeed only a single side of the whole state life newly formed far and wide in our time, and if we do not want to disparage what concerns the moral life of men, we shall hold this side to be very important; at the same time we shall also gratefully acknowledge the attention paid to it and the changes made in it as one of the good fruits of this time; for this time too has borne good fruits.

The general picture which we have before us of the last period of more than twenty years may appear to us above all as a picture of the destruction of the old, of the violation and shattering of what is in itself or through its age venerable, so that change so often presents itself as equivalent to loss.

If men were held and kept in suspense too long and so often found themselves deceived again in the future to which they had been referred for the fruits of their sacrifices, it is comprehensible that they should attach the objects of their longing to the past or to the little which has perhaps only provisionally escaped transformation.

This mood we have to meet with the observation that what has passed is missed and wished back in vain, that the old is not excellent because it is old, and that because it was appropriate and comprehensible under other circumstances, nothing less follows from this than that its preservation under changed circumstances is still to be desired, but rather the opposite, - that however still more a deeper contemplation, which starts from the absolute belief in the divine government of the world, recognises with insight even in our time the day of an essential bettering, in part already dawning, in part in its morning red; the spirit, firm in that belief, will forcibly tear itself from its in part justified sadness, and soon be able to perceive many gratifying fruits and appearances which announce to it something better in the making.
zh: 至于新时代以来、并通过我们至仁政府的筹划所成就和所规定的那一切有关青年教育的事情固然只是我们这个时代广泛重新形成的国家生活的一个侧面；但如果我们不愿轻视那些关乎人的道德生活的东西，我们就会认为这一侧面极为重要；同时我们也会感激地承认，对它的关注以及在其中所作的改变，正是这个时代所结出的美好果实之一；因为这个时代也结出了美好的果实。
我们面前这二十多年的最后一段时期的整体图景，或许在我们看来主要是一幅古老者被摧毁、本身可敬或因年岁而可敬之物被伤害、被砸碎的画面，以至于变化如此频繁地显得与损失是同一回事。
如果人们被拖延、悬置得太久，并且在那个他们被指望以此收获自己牺牲之果的未来中一次又一次地发现受骗，那么他们把自己的渴望寄托于过去、寄托于那也许只是暂时逃过转变的少数事物，就是可以理解的了。

对这种心情，我们须这样回应：已经过去的东西被徒然地思念、徒然地企盼回来；古老者并不因为它古老就卓越；而正因为它在别的处境下曾是合宜的、可理解的，由此得出的结论绝不应是它在改变了的情境中仍然值得保存，毋宁说恰恰相反。——但更进一步的是，一种更深的考察——它从对神的治世之绝对信仰出发——使我们带着洞察在我们这个时代也辨认出：那个本质性地变好之日的到来，或是已经黎明，或是正在它的曙光中；那牢固地持守这一信仰的精神，将以强力挣脱它那部分有道理的忧郁，不久的将来便能看出许多令人欣慰的果实和现象，它们向他预示着某种更好的东西正在生成。

en: It remains just as certain, however, that such a fateful time also breathes out a bad odour and threatens to breathe its corrupting influences into the unguarded mind.
It is important that the inner life of the young, so that they may have part in the better fruits of the spirit of the time, be protected from this evil.

If we saw the old firm order torn to pieces in manifold ways and new ephemeral orders built up with a light hand, then the disposition and the inner respect for the immutability of right and of the legal institution suffer, even if outward obedience is still kept up so far as necessary; the representation, moved by the great interests and events of the day, lets itself be torn out of the circle of a quiet activity into the spirit of unrestrainedness or also of indifference and relaxation.

The study of the sciences in the quiet circle of the school is the most appropriate means of giving the young an interest and an occupation which shuts them out from and protects them against the noise and the seductive influence of the fermenting conditions of the time.
It must then be a double care of the parents and guardians to supervise and watch over their wards.
It is difficult to find the middle path between too great a freedom allowed to the children and too great a restriction of it.
Insofar as both are a fault, the former is probably the greater.
If the good-naturedness of the parents is pleased to grant the children an innocent freedom, one should see well to it whether it is really innocent and remains so.

Since it is easier to love children than to educate them, the parents have to examine whether convenience is not part of it when they entrust their sons to themselves, without having them under their eyes and accompanying them with their attention.

In modern education the principle has undoubtedly done much harm that the worldliness should be taught to children early and that they should be introduced into society, that is, into the amusements and diversions of adults, or that such things should be prepared for them in the way of adults.

Experience refutes this thought, for it shows rather that men who had laid a solid inner foundation and had otherwise been brought up in good habits were also soon equal to the habit of outward demeanour and conduct in the world, that excellent men of the world have themselves come out of the most restricted monastic life, that on the other hand men who were brought up in this externality of life do not come to any inner core either.

It requires little thought to find this comprehensible; in order to be able to appear with thoroughness and advantage, the inner ground must have been cultivated and strongly drawn; the youth, which sees only the glitter of outward life and the importance with which men who otherwise have standing and significance for her behave in it, takes this sometimes for the whole and sometimes for the only seriousness, because she does not at the same time come to know the substantial and genuinely serious, which such persons also carry on besides that recreation, thereby gets a false notion of the value of things and at the same time pleases herself with this dissipation, which is joined with no exertion and with pleasure; she learns to slight what is held in esteem and made a duty in the school, and to shy away from the exertion which the same imposes on her!
zh: 不过，同样确定的是：这样一个命运多舛的时代也会呼出恶劣的气息，并威胁着把败坏的影响吹进未加守护的心灵。
重要的是：青年的内在生活必须防备这种祸害，以便他们能够分享时代精神中较好的果实。
如果我们曾看到那古老的稳固秩序被以种种方式撕碎，又看到新的、稍纵即逝的秩序被轻率地搭起，那么心态与对法之不可变性以及对法定制度的内心敬意就会受损——即便表面的服从还勉力维持着；而那被当日重大的利害与事件所推动的表象，会任由自己从安静活动的范围中被拽出，落到无所拘束的精神、或者漠然与松懈的精神之中。
在学校这一安静的范围内研究学问，是给予青年一种兴趣和一种业务的最佳手段，这种兴趣与业务使他们避开躁动时代局势的喧嚣及其诱惑性的影响，并保护他们不受其害。
于是，父母与监护人便须加倍费心，去监督和看护自己所监护的少年。
要在给予孩子的过分自由与对这种自由的过分限制之间找到中间道路，是困难的。
就两者都是一种过错而言，前者大概更为严重。
如果父母出于好心乐意给孩子们一种无害的自由，那么大概还得照看着，看它是否真的无害并且保持无害。
由于爱孩子比教育孩子容易，父母就得查一查：当他们把儿子托付给他们自己、不让他们留在自己眼前、也不以自己的看护加以陪伴时，这里是否掺杂着图省事的成分。
在现代教育中，把世故早早地教给儿童、让他们进入社交——也就是进入成年人的娱乐与消遣——或者以成年人的方式替他们预备这类东西，这条原则无疑造成了很大的伤害。
经验驳倒了这一想法，因为它恰恰表明：那些打好了坚实内在根基、并且在别的方面按良好习惯受到教养的人，很快也就习惯了在世上那种表面的举止与做派；那些杰出的处世老手自己就出自最狭隘的僧侣生活；相反，那些在这种生活的外在性中被教养起来的人，则同样达不到任何内在的核心。

要理解这一点并不需要多少思考；要想以扎实与有利的方式出现，内在的根基就必须得到培育并被培植得坚强；那只看得到外显生活的浮光以及那些本来在它看来有声望、有分量的人在其中举止之重要性的青年，把这一切有时当作全部的严肃、有时当作唯一的严肃，因为她并不同时认识那实质性的、真正严肃的东西——那些人在那之外还从事的这类事——于是她便对事物的价值形成了错误的概念，同时又喜欢这种不费力气而带着乐趣的涣散；她学着轻视那些在学校里受到尊重、被规定为义务的东西，并且躲避学校给她规定的那种劳苦！

en: There is, however, another side dangerous for the young, which seems to be more closely connected with the study itself.

The feeling of the true value which man thereby gives himself, the importance and magnitude of the objects with which he occupies himself, can lead the young into imagining their own maturity and into claiming the independent conduct of adults and equality in their enjoyments and outward way of life.

However much the parents may be satisfied with what their sons achieve and have such good confidence in them, it is nevertheless important not to put the reins into their hands and not to consider the continued necessary supervision and discipline superfluous.
This freedom left to them out of confidence carries with it above all the danger of lapsing into follies, bad habits and even into excess and wrongdoing.

Let us, the parents and the teachers, support each other in the purpose of the moral formation of the pupils; through this union we may hope to see our work of educating them into able, sturdy and moral men crowned with success.

It is above all reserved to the rising generation to one day reap in full the fruits of what good has come out of so many years of confusion and distress and is still to develop from it; may it, and we with it, have the storms of the time behind us; so it will be able, not clouded by the memory of suffered loss and by the habit of other circumstances, to grasp with youthful freshness the new forms of life which we saw come into being and whose greater maturity we are approaching.
The world has born a great epoch; may you, young men, form yourselves worthy of it, win the higher fitness which it demands, and thereby also the happiness which is to emerge from it.
zh: 不过另有一个对青年而言危险的方面，它似乎与学业本身有更切近的关联。
人由此赋予自己的真实价值之感，以及他借以忙碌的那些对象的重要性和规模，都可能诱使青年自以为已经成熟，进而要求享有成年人那种独立行事的方式、在享受和外在生活方式上与成年人平起平坐。
无论家长对自己的儿子们所取得的成绩多么满意、对他们抱有怎样的信任，仍然要紧的是不要把缰绳交到他们手里，也不要认为那持续不断的必要监督与训育是可以省免的。
这份出于信任而留给他们的自由，最主要地带着这样的危险：陷入蠢行、恶劣的习惯，甚至陷入放荡与罪过。
让我们——家长与教师——在塑造学生们的道德教养这一目的上彼此支持；通过这种联合，我们可以指望看到我们把他们教育成灵巧、刚健而有道德的人的工作获得成功。
把这多年的混乱与困苦中所产生的一切善及其仍将从中发展出的成果将来充分地收获，这是正在兴起的这一代首先被赋予的使命；愿她和我们在她一起把时代的风暴抛在身后；如此，她便能在不因对所受损失的回忆、不因对别种境况的习惯而受蒙蔽的情况下，以青年的鲜活去把握我们目睹其产生、并且我们正迎向其更加成熟的新生活形式。
世界已经孕育出一个伟大的时代；愿你们各位少年把自己培养得配得上它，获得它所要求的那种更高的适格，从而也获得应当从中产生的幸福。

en: And now we pass over to the distribution of the annual prizes to those who have earned this distinction by diligence, progress and good conduct.
zh: 而现在我们转向分发年度奖品，把它们授予那些以勤勉、进步和端正品行赢得这一表彰的人。

27.en: 1. Report on the position of the real institute in relation to the other institutions of study109)
27.zh: 1. 关于实科学校相对于其他学校之地位的鉴定书109)

en: Nuremberg, the 19th
of September
zh: 纽伦堡，19 日
9 月

en: Royal general commissariat!
zh: 皇家总务署！

en: Through a most gracious rescript of the royal
general commissariat of the 15th
August, praes. eod., there was delivered to the undersigned rectorate of the royal
ministerial decree, Munich, 1.

August, the following: "regarding the results of the experiences so far made, though still imperfect, concerning the real institute, as well as regarding the wishes of the public that have been observed, to submit, with the assistance of some teachers, a detailed report, giving the most particular consideration to three questions, in most humble submission".
zh: 通过皇家总务署最恩赐的敕令，
于 8 月 15 日，
当日呈送下署的校务委员会：王室
部长令，慕尼黑，8 月 1. 日，
已送达，内容为：「关于迄今（尽管尚不完善）在实科学校方面所得经验的结果，以及关于所观察到的公众的愿望，在有几位教师协助的情况下，恭呈一份详尽的鉴定书，其中着重地考虑三个问题。」

en: The undersigned has, in accordance with this highest command, held a conference on the 18th with the gymnasium professors and both sub-rectors
of August on this matter, but has only been able to draw up the most humble report later, because of the examinations and the business of the distribution of prizes.
zh: 下署者已依这道至高的命令，于 8 月 18 日与文科中学的教授们以及两位副校长就此举行了会议，
但由于考试以及分发奖品的事务的缘故，关于此事的恭呈报告只能在此之后再撰写出来。

en: The wishes of the public and above all the experiences concerning the aforementioned subject must, from the nature of the case, have come closer to the rectorate of the real institute than to the undersigned [rectorate]; the more determinate data necessary for the assessment are lacking to the latter, and so it can in this respect only extend to the aspects that have entered into its range of vision.
zh: 公众的愿望、尤其是关于上述事项的经验，按事情本身的性质，必定更接近实科学校的校务委员会，而不是下署的[校务委员会]；后者缺少评价所必需的更确切资料，因此在这一点上只能就进入其视野的诸方面展开。

en: In the first place the remark may be prefixed that the wishes of the public will in general not be taken into consideration here in so far as there are parents who wish to see simply the advancement of their children in the world accomplished with the least exertion on the part of the latter and the least cost on their own side, who unfortunately regard the necessary spiritual and scientific training as a mere means and bitter condition of which they would gladly see their children relieved, or at least who get through it as shortly and conveniently as possible.

Such parents in particular remember of the Greek and Latin language only the bitter toil which they had to spend on it in their youth under bad arrangements and after bad methods; in part, however, they are ungrateful towards this instruction and believe they see no benefit in it if they make no direct use of these languages, - because they never reached the insight and consciousness of the spiritual influence which that formation had upon them and which still has upon them without their knowledge.

Over the views of this part of the public, which wishes its children the harvest without their having to plough and to sow, the better part of the public itself is above it, still more however the highest government, and it strikes down such wishes through the demands which the same makes both with regard to the fitness for the service of the state in its particular branches and with regard to the general formation of a state servant, and which has so great, indeed the very greatest influence on that particular fitness.
zh: 首先可以预先指出一点：公众的愿望在这里一般说来不予考虑，因为有这样的父母：他们只希望自己的孩子在世上出人头地，而这既不费孩子的多少力气，也不花自己多少代价；他们不幸把那种必要的精神与学术上的造就仅仅看作一种手段和一项苦涩的条件，因而巴不得让自己的孩子免于这份负担，或者至少希望尽快、最省事地了结此事。
尤其是这样的父母，对希腊文和拉丁文只记得自己在少年时代于糟糕的制度和糟糕的方法之下所不得不付出的辛劳；不过在某种程度上，他们对这种教学是不感恩的，并且当他们不能直接使用这些语言时，便认为从中看不到任何益处——因为他们从未达到那种洞察与意识，即那种养成曾经给他们、并且至今仍然在不为他们所知的情况下给他们带来的精神影响。
对于公众中这一部分人的见解——他们希望孩子收获，却不必去耕田播种——公众中较好的一部分本身就对此不屑，至高政府则更是如此；它以自己对国家公务各个具体部门的适用性、以及对一个国家公务人员之一般教养所提出的要求，驳倒这类愿望；而这些要求对那种具体适用性有着如此巨大、乃至最大的影响。

en: Through these demands and through the needs of the state, that is primarily established which the public must, in respect of the institutions of study, regard more as needs, in which the young are trained for the fitness for the state, and accordingly are regulated both the determinations which are given to the young and the wishes of the public to find opportunities to make them fit for it.
zh: 正是通过这些要求和国家的需要，才主要确定了：公众对于学校究竟必须提出什么样的更切近的要求——在这些学校里，青年是为对国家的适用性而受造就的；而据此，给青年所定的各项规定，以及公众希望找到机会使自己人胜任这一点的那些愿望，也都以之为准。

en: From what emerged unanimously from the conference of the teachers that was held, it now indeed seemed as if a particular wish of the public had not been noticed, that there should be a public opportunity for young people, after two years' attendance at the Realschule, to pursue a four-year course at a real institute, in order to prepare themselves there, as in an intermediate institution, for the university.

On this point, however, the rectorate of the real institute will be able to give definite information as to how many pupils and of what kind are to be found there who want not merely to pursue a one- or two-year course but a complete four-year course, and indeed in order afterwards to enter the university.

As for how far the public may harbour this wish, or may harbour it still more in future in view of felt needs, the undersigned rectorate believes that, in accordance with the scope of the highest command, it has the following circumstances to set out in this report in most humble submission.
zh: 从所举行的教师会议上一致得出的结果来看，当时确实似乎并未察觉到公众有一个特别的愿望：即应当有一种公共的机会，让年轻人在实科中学就读两年之后，在一所实科学校中修习四年的课程，以便在其中作为一所为大学作准备的中级学校而受到造就。
关于这一点，实科学校的校务委员会则能提供确切的说明：那里有多少、什么样的学生，他们不只是想修读一年或两年的课程，而是想修完完整的四年课程，为的是此后再去上大学。
至于公众能够怀抱这一愿望到什么程度，或者将来因所感到的需要而更加怀抱这一愿望到什么程度，下署的校务委员会认为，按照这道至高命令的范围，它在本鉴定书中须恭呈以下各项情由。

en: Considering more closely the individual determinations for which a higher preparatory institution is necessary, for those destined for theology and jurisprudence the gymnasium studies are, according to unanimous understanding, indispensable.

Whether the same is the case with regard to medicine (this science and its art considered absolutely, or at least according to the state in which it is still found), this investigation does not fall within the competence of the undersigned

rectorate; here it need only be mentioned that even if the gymnasium studies were not absolutely necessary for that, this notion is still completely prevailing among the public, and there will hardly be a father who would not wish to have his son, whom he destines for medicine, make those studies.
Still more is the positive determination to be cited, that according to the most high
commands (Reg.
Bl.
1808, S. 2894 f.) the written and oral examinations of the medical students before the medical committees are to take place in Latin.
zh: 更仔细地考察那些需要更高一级预备学校的各项专业规定，那么按照一致的看法，对于以神学和法学为去向的[学生]来说，文科中学的学习是不可或缺的。
至于就医学而言（把这一科学及其技艺绝对地看，或至少按照它现在的实际状况来看）是否同样如此，这一考察不属下署校务委员会的职权范围；
这里只能指出这一点：即便文科中学的学习对医学并非绝对必要，这一想法在公众中仍然完全占统治地位，而且几乎不会有哪位父亲不愿让自己那个被指定去学医的儿子走那条学习之路。
更须援引一条明确的规定：根据至高的
命令（Reg.
Bl.
1808 年，S. 2894 f.），医科学生的笔试与口试在医学委员会前举行时都应当用拉丁语进行。

en: Furthermore this necessity is acknowledged for those who want to devote themselves to the teaching office in the schools of study or the institutions of study.
zh: 此外，对于那些想要担任学校或学院之教学职务的人而言，这一必要性也已得到承认。

en: For other determinations, on the other hand, the gymnasium studies may seem less necessary.
It is true that their completion is demanded by the highest of those who "aspire in the state-economy and cameral field to positions higher than mere chancery posts" (Reg.
Bl.
1809, S. 1332), further the post-office candidates (Reg.
Bl.
1808, S. 937), for the pupils of the topographical school (Reg.
Bl.
But since maturity certificates for the university can be issued from the real institutes, this will also have to extend to the last-mentioned determinations.

How far, with regard to the aspirants to higher state-economy and cameral posts, the knowledge of the ancient languages and of classical literature is superfluous and it is indifferent to them whether they pursue the gymnasium or the real-institute studies, lies outside the range of vision of the undersigned
rectorate; it is known to it only so far that the study of cameral science is customarily often combined with the study of jurisprudence, as also according to the most high
ordinances candidates can have themselves examined for both relevant high posts.

The undersigned must however leave it to higher judgement to determine how far the study of jurisprudence is superfluous for higher financial posts, and to leave unmentioned how far they are thereby also relieved of the higher formation peculiar to the gymnasium institution.

At least this much is granted, that those for whom the way through the real institute is open may also choose the way through the gymnasium, and the highest that need be said is perhaps that they may learn in the latter something which is not directly useful to them for empirical use, but otherwise on this path equally acquire the proper preparation for every subject which is to be studied at the university.
zh: 至于其他的专业，反倒可能显得文科中学的学习并非那样必要。
诚然，最高当局要求那些「在国家经济与官房事务方面志在高于单纯文书职员职位者」（Reg.
Bl.
1809 年，S. 1332）完成这一要求，此外还有邮政事务的候补者（Reg.
Bl.
1808 年，S. 937），以及地形学校的学员（Reg.
Bl.
不过，既然实科学校可以颁发升大学的结业证书，这一规定也就同样必须延伸到上述最后提到的那些专业。
至于就那些志在更高的国家经济与官房职位的人来说，古语言的学问与古典文学是否可省，以及他们对文科中学还是实科学校的学习是否无所谓，这都在下署校务委员会的视野之外；
它所知的仅仅是：官房学的学习通常与法学的学习相互结合起来，正如根据那些至高的
法令，候补者可以在两个相关的高位前接受考核。
不过，对于更高的财政职位而言，法学学习是否可省，须留给上级的裁断；至于他们因此也就免除了文科中学所特有的那种更高教养，这一点则不予提及。
至少已经获准的是：那些实科学校之路为他们敞开的人，也可以选择文科中学之路；而所能说的至多是这样：他们或许在后者中学到一些对他们并非直接用于实际用途的东西，此外则在这条路上同样获得了大学中所应学习的每一门专业的适当准备。

en: According to the experience so far made from the gymnasium, such pupils have either been advised by the rectorate to apply for admission to the real institute, or [such] have of their own accord taken this resolution, in whom it was visible that they were making no progress in the gymnasium studies, and this includes not only the ancient languages but also the remaining subjects of instruction.

In general the undersigned rectorate cannot find the incapacity for the ancient languages in a lack of a specific talent for them, but in the incapacity for a higher spiritual formation taken as a whole.
Those who renounce the ancient languages have on the other hand to learn the modern ones, and the lack of talent for the former would also include the latter, if it were only about languages.

But with the learning of the ancient languages the higher study of grammatical concepts is connected first, and then that of classical literature, and in this the peculiarity of the gymnasium instruction is above all to be set; but since these subjects either possessed no aptitudes for this or had let the development of them slip in earlier youth, it was not to be expected of them that they would make great progress in a scientific higher formation, even if it were to bear a form other than that of classical study.
zh: 根据迄今文科中学方面所获得的经验，这样的人要么由校务委员会建议去申请进入实科学校，要么是[他们]自己下了这个决心——因为在他们身上明显地看出，他们在文科中学的学习中没有进步；这不仅包括古语言，也包括其余的各个教学科目。
总之下署的校务委员会不能把对古语言的无能力归结为欠缺这方面的特殊才能，而只能归结为整体上无力于一种更高层次的精神教养。
那些放弃古语言的人，反倒要去学习近代语言；如果事情仅仅是语言问题，那么对前者的才能不足也会连带着包含后者。
不过，与古语言的学习相连的，首先是语法概念的较高研究，其次是古典文学的研究；而文科中学教学的特殊性，主要就应当设定在这里面；但由于这些主体要么本就没有这方面的禀赋，要么在更早的少年时代耽误了这种禀赋的培养，因此不能期待它们在一种学术性的更高教养中取得大的进展——无论这种教养采取的是与古典研究不同的另一种形式。

en: As to what condition and destination those persons have who entered the real institute from outside and have the purpose of completing their course for the university, the rectorate of the same will be able to give information.
So much the undersigned

[rectorate] must suppose: that among them there will be some who have been brought up too comfortably, too nobly and too indulgently for their parents and then they themselves to require of them that they should apply themselves seriously to learning and take on the exertion which the study of the ancient languages requires.
zh: 至于那些从外面进入实科学校、并且其目的在于修完课程而升入大学的人究竟是什么样的素质与志向，本校的校务委员会将能作出说明。
下署的
[校务委员会]必须认为：其中会有一些人被教养得过于安逸、过于娇贵和过于娇纵，以致他们的父母、继而他们自己，都不会对他们提出认真从事学习、承担研习古语言所需之劳力的要求。

en: Ob die Anzahl derer, die aus solchen Gründen den Weg durch das Realinstitut aus Belieben wählen wollen, groß genug sein möge, um ein vollständiges Institut für sie notwendig zu machen, inwiefern man auf ein solches Belieben Rücksicht nehmen wolle, - ob viele aus den anderen Teilen des Königreichs, statt das Gymnasium ihrer Vater- oder Kreisstadt, das ihnen die Gelegenheit der Vorbereitung zur Universität oder jenen anderen Fächern gewährt, zu frequentieren, die Realinstitute aufsuchen [werden], ob viele Auswärtige zu erwarten seien, diese Fragen fallen außer der Erfahrung und dem Gesichtskreise des unterzeichneten.

Also the general decline in the number of students, as the cost of studying becomes ever greater, and here especially because of the stagnation for years in the payment of the scholarships and, more recently, also in their distribution, will perhaps also come into consideration. - The gymnasium here has at present still not so large a number of pupils that it could not, in this respect too, comfortably take in those who wished to prepare themselves for the university through the real institute.
zh: 至于那些出于上述理由而自愿选择走实科学校这条路的人，其人数是否足够大以致有必要为他们设立一所完整的学校，是否应当顾及这种自愿——王国的其他地区是否会有许多人不去就读其出生之城或专区之城的文科中学（那里为他们提供升大学或学习其他专业的准备机会），而转而频频造访实科学校，是否应当期待许多外来者——这些问题都在下署者的经验与视野之外。
此外，随着求学费用日益增高而学生人数普遍减少——在这里尤其是由于奖学金的发放多年来停滞不前，近来连分配也滞碍——这一点或许也值得考虑。——本地文科中学目前还没有这样多的学生，以至于在这一方面不能同样宽裕地接纳那些想通过实科学校为上大学作准备的人。

en: If there were a sufficient number of those who wanted to enter the university from the real institute, it would further have to be pointed out that for them such an institution would rather take the place of a Lyceum than of an intermediate institution parallel to the gymnasium.

Since they, counting the Realschule in, study for five years mathematics (which for medical men is already too much), and in addition physics, mineralogy, botany, zoology, chemistry and so on to some extent, it is superfluous for them still to do the general course at the university or in a Lyceum; they can enter directly on their particular course of the subject; but there would remain unfilled for them the gap which the gymnasium studies, as the study of the humanities, constitute as the general human formation, which is the middle between school instruction and the study of the other particular sciences, and which will always have to be regarded as the foundation of all higher spiritual science and formation.
zh: 如果这样的学生（想从实科学校升入大学者）人数足够多，那么还须指出：对他们而言，这样一所机构与其说是与文科中学平行的中级学校，不如说更适合充当高级中学的位置。

因为他们（把实科中学的两年也算在内）连续五年学习数学（对医科学生而言本已过多），此外还在一定范围内学习物理、矿物学、植物学、动物学、化学等等，所以他们再去大学或高级中学修读通行的课程就是多余的了；他们可以直接开始本专业的专门课程；但文科中学的学习作为人文诸科之学所构成的那种人的普遍教养——它处在学校教育与其他各门专门科学的研究之间的中间，并且总之始终应被看作一切更高的精神科学与教养的基础——所留下的那个空缺，对他们来说仍然是填不满的。

en: Sometimes individual persons who have made physics or chemistry, natural history and the like their exclusive science are cited as examples that there are determinations for which the gymnasium studies are superfluous.

Such individual cases, however, are not to be taken into account; no father will have a mind to give his son such a determination which, as an exclusive science, is scarcely needed for any posts in the state; those in whom such an inclination shows itself later can move over to it from the general preparatory institutions, and it will have been useful to them to have attended one of those before.
zh: 有时人们会举出个别的人作为例子——他们把物理或化学、自然史以及诸如此类作为自己专门的学问——以此说明有些专业是不需要文科中学的学习的。
不过这样的个别情形是不必考虑的；没有哪位父亲会愿意给自己的儿子定下这样的专业——作为专门的学问，它在国家中几乎不为任何职位所必需；那些后来显出这种倾向的人，可以从一般预备学校转过去，而事先曾就读过这样一所学校，对他们将是益处。

en: Besides the determinations cited so far, however, there are many for which on the one hand a real institute can be almost an indispensable necessity, and on the other hand it is hardly possible to stay in it four years, up to the 18th
year of life, to remain.
zh: 不过，除了迄今所提到的那些专业之外，还有许多专业：对它们来说，一方面实科学校几乎是一种不可或缺的必要之物，另一方面又很难在其中一直待上四年，直到

en: Thus one destined for the military estate will hardly be willing to remain at a general preparatory course up to this age, but rather up to the 16th
year will have had time to train himself in the necessary theoretical knowledge, so as to enter on his career at that age.
Especially since such a person in the royal

cadet house at Munich finds for his destination a special school, in whose plan it is at the same time stated that, besides the acquisition of the theoretical knowledge, the definite orientation towards this estate must be taken in good time and the particular practical exercises and skills must be acquired.
zh: 因此，被指定走军人身份这条路的人不会愿意在一般预备课程中一直待到这样的年纪；相反，到了 16
岁之前，他们就有足够的时间在必要的理论知识上造就自己，以便在这个年纪踏入自己的军旅生涯。
何况这样一个人在慕尼黑的
王家军校中，为其志向找到一所专门学校；该校计划中同时言明：除了获取理论知识之外，还须及早选定朝向军人身份的方向，并学会特别的实践操练与技能。

en: Those devoted to the art of land, water, road construction [and] land surveying cannot stay at a purely theoretical course up to the 18th

year, but have need to exercise themselves early in the required practical skills and to acquire empirical knowledge and abilities, and then to employ the largest part of their time, especially the short daytime in winter, on this.
They will, if no special schools for these branches exist, attach themselves as assistants to a master builder long before the 18th
year of life.
zh: 那些献身于陆上工程、水利、筑路与土地测量之术的人，不能在纯粹理论的课程中一直停留到 18
岁，而必须尽早练习所必需的实际技能，并获得经验的知识与本领，然后把这段时间中的绝大部分——尤其是冬季短暂的白昼时间——都用在这上面。
如果这些领域没有专门的学校，他们就会在 18
岁之前很久，就作为助手投身于一位营造师傅的门下。

en: The same will be the case with those devoted to the science of forestry; after the acquisition of the necessary school and general knowledge, in the 16th or 17th

year of life they will seek to attach themselves to a forestry officer, or else go earlier to a forestry institute, as there are of these where they are at the same time introduced in good time into their particular subject alongside the theoretical knowledge.
zh: 那些献身于林业科学的人情形也将如此；他们在获取必要的学校知识和一般知识之后，会在 16 岁或 17
岁时去投靠一位林业官员，或者更早地进入一所林业学校——这样的学校是有的，在那里他们除了理论学问之外，还会及早被引入自己专门的业务。

en: Artists whose works constitute a significant branch of the local industry cannot be satisfied, with the instruction in drawing which they receive at the real institute, up to the 18th
year, still making a purely scientific formation their main concern, but have early to practise hand and eye in unremitting effort, and must in winter husband the day for their art.
If the city here through the highest grace of his royal

majesty had the good fortune to obtain an art school, then either provision will be made in it itself for the study of the older and newer languages, of history, mythology, geometry and so on, or it would seem possible so to arrange matters that the pupils, after completing the instruction in the Realschule, should attend alongside the lessons of the real institute useful to them, since their destination will hardly permit that they take regular part even up to the 16th
year in all the lessons of the same.
zh: 那些作品构成本地工业重要分支的艺术家，不会在实科学校所给的绘画指导上一味满足到 18
岁还只把纯粹科学的教养当作自己的主业；相反，他们必须尽早地以不懈的努力练习手与眼，并且冬季里必须节省地把白昼用于自己的艺术。
如果本地城市有幸蒙国王陛下
的至高恩典而设立一所艺术学校，那么或者将在该校内部安排古代与近代语言、历史、神话学、几何学等的学习，或者似乎可以这样设置：学生们在完成实科中学的教学之后，顺便旁听实科学校中对他们有用的课程，因为他们的志向大概不会容许他们连直到 16
岁都经常参加它的所有课程。

en: Those who want to learn commerce are accustomed in this city in the 14th

year to go over to it; even the most respected commercial houses let their sons run through this early and wholly practical course; they perhaps allow one year for the general formation; the learning, especially of the newer languages, which is still to take place or to be continued during the apprenticeship or later, is carried on alongside in evening hours.
Even to attend a commercial institute, which is after all a special school, is not the spirit of the merchants of this city.
zh: 那些想要学做买卖的人，在本地通常在 14
岁上就开始走这条道；本地最有名气的商号也让自己的儿子们走这条早而全实务的路子；它们大概只给一般教养留出一年的时间；在学徒期间或后来还要进行、尤其是近代语言的学习，则在晚间课时顺带进行。
至于去上一所商业专科学校——那毕竟是一所专门学校——这并不是本地商人的精神。

en: This second class of determinations lies in the middle between those which demand a higher scientific formation, for which the gymnasia, lycea and universities are above all intended, and the tradesman's estate, whose formation is the concern of the elementary schools.
zh: 这第二类专业处在中间：一头是那些要求更高学术教养的领域，文科中学、高级中学和大学主要是为它们而设；另一头是手工业者的阶层，其教养则由公立小学承担。

en: For such intermediate determinations it is a high necessity to counteract the merely empirical preparation for the branches of the state service comprehended under them, and the blind training for it by mere routine, by providing for a scientific grounding of the necessary knowledge and for other formation of the mind of those destined for it.

The highest government has most loudly acknowledged this so important purpose in the prescribed conditions of the state service. - On the other hand the acquisition of technical skills, empirical knowledge and the practical eye is to be linked early with the theoretical study.
zh: 对于这类中间性的专业来说，一项重大而必要的事就是：要防止对其中所包含的国家公务各个部门只作经验性的准备，防止仅仅靠成规造成的盲目训练；也就是要为必要的知识提供科学的根据，并为那些注定走这条路的人的精神提供其他方面的教养。
至高政府已在国家公务的既定条件中极其明确地承认了这一如此重要的宗旨。——另一方面，技术本领、经验知识和实践眼力的获得，必须尽早地与理论学习结合起来。

en: It is a natural wish of the public to find special schools for determinations of that kind, such as the military estate, forestry, the art of land, water, road construction and land surveying, the art of the painter, the sculptor, the copperplate engraver, in which both are combined, in which the two one-sidednesses, of merely blindly following routine and of mere theory without practice, are avoided.
Such special schools can, as the plan of the royal
cadet house at Munich shows, begin with the elements of the theoretical knowledge, and the parents can thus let their children begin the course from them at such an institution.

But with most of these determinations it will be sufficient and with some of them even advantageous to devote some years after the school instruction to a general formation and a scientific grounding of the knowledge.
These general knowledge are indeed the same as a whole for those particular determinations.
zh: 公众有一个自然的愿望：为诸如军人身份、林业、陆地与水利与筑路和土地测量之术、绘画、雕塑与铜版雕刻之术一类的专业，找到把两者结合起来的专门学校，以避免仅仅盲目地按成规行事和只有理论而无实践这两种偏于一端。
这样的专门学校可以——正如慕尼黑王家
军校的计划所显示的那样——从理论知识的要素开始；因此父母可以让孩子们在这样的学校里从这些要素接着学起。
不过，对这些专业中的大多数来说，在学校教育之后再花几年时间于一般教养和知识的科学根据之上，就足够了；对其中一些来说，这甚至是有利的。
这些一般知识，对那些专门专业来说，总的来说毕竟是一样的。

en: They find the satisfaction of this need in a real institute, in which mathematics, together with practical geometry, physics, chemistry, natural history, history, geography, grammar, logic and the modern sciences are taught, so that the whole course lasts two years or four semesters.

The special schools need less to descend to institutions for the learning of the first elements, since they can reckon on the proper preparation in the general institutions of instruction, the secondary schools and then such real institutes.
Those who do not find special schools for their subject can from this preparation to advantage attach themselves as assistants to an official.
zh: 他们在一个实科学校中找到了这一需要的满足：在那里教授数学（连同实用几何学）、物理、化学、自然史、历史、地理、语法、逻辑学和近代科学，因而全部课程为期两年，即四个学期。
专门学校就更不必降格到那些用来学习最初要素的机构上去了，因为它们可以指望在一般学校、中学以及随后的实科学校中得到应有的准备。
那些找不到本专业专门学校的人，可以从这一准备出发，有利地作为助手投身于某位官员的门下。

en: Those also who devote themselves to commerce or hasten to prepare for a lower administrative post, for a writing room, future apothecaries, find the advantage open of taking part in one or more courses.

If the real institutes are closed institutes for those proper pupils, so that they have to attend all the lessons prescribed in the plan, then there will still be found a large number of those such as the last mentioned, artists too, who will wish to take part in individual lessons only.
In general in a large city it is a need to have the opportunity to be able to do a course in physics, chemistry and so on.

Such an institution will be used by so many more the more it adapts itself for this purpose to the general business needs with regard to the hours of the day, above all if it is placed in connection with an art school or takes the artists into consideration.
zh: 那些从事商业的人、那些急着为较低的行政职位、为一个文书房作准备的人，以及未来的药剂师，也都发现可以从中获利，参加一个或多个课程。
如果实科学校对那些本校生是封闭的机构，即他们必须听遍计划中规定的所有课程，那么仍会有大量像最后提到的那类人——艺术家也包括在内——希望只参加个别课程。
总的说来，在一座大城市里，能够有机会就物理、化学等等修读一门课程，乃是一种需要。
这样一所机构会为更多人所使用，如果它为着这一目的顾及一般的事务需要而按照一天的时段来安排，尤其是当它与一所艺术学校相联合，或者照顾到艺术家的需要时。

en: After the consideration of these general points of view, the undersigned
rectorate passes over to the most humble answer of the special points whose consideration has been most graciously enjoined:
zh: 在考察了这些一般性的观点之后，下署的校务委员会
转入对那些被恩准要求加以考虑的特殊问题的恭呈答复：

en: "whether in any respect the subjects of instruction of the real and the gymnasium institute can be combined, so as to save one or the other teaching post".
zh: 「是否可以在某一点上把实科学校与文科中学的教学科目合并起来，以省去这一方或那一方的教师职位」。

en: This saving might be thought possible in the following three manners:
zh: 这项节省被认为可以用以下三种方式来实现：

en: a) that teachers of the gymnasium also give lessons at the real institute, or conversely.
zh: a) 文科中学的教师也在实科学校上课，或者反过来。

en: Since the gymnasium institution already has its complete equipment and regular extension, the professors have not only the number of teaching hours determined by the most gracious ordinance, but the class teachers at present give more than that lawful number. - As regards the special teachers of mathematics and the philosophical preparatory sciences, they do not have so many teaching hours as the former according to the most high

ordinance; but it would be to be hoped from the grace of the highest government that a number of hours should be taken off from the one of them upon whom the rectorate is imposed, since the business not connected with this office has become so very heavy and it cannot be attended to in all the duties of the office, especially in the case of an extensive institution, among others the visiting of the classes, to the extent which the importance of the matter and the good of the institution require. - With respect to the professors of the real institute it would be the same case if the full number of classes were established.
zh: 由于文科中学已经具备完整的设置和规整的规模，所以教授们拥有的不只是至仁命令所规定的授课时数，各班的班主任教师目前所授的课时还远远多于那个法定的数目。至于数学与哲学预备学科的专任教师，根据至高的
规章，他们的授课时数并不像前者那样多；但可以期望至高的政府的恩典，会从被委以校务委员会职务的那一位身上减去一些课时，因为与这一职务无关的事务已经过于繁重，而且在所有该项义务中——尤其在一所规模庞大的学校里，其中包括巡视各班级——都不能按照事情的重要性和学校的利益所要求的程度去履行。——就实科学校的教授们而言，如果各班级的数目都设立齐备，情况也是一样的。

en: b) that instruction in individual subjects would be given jointly to the pupils of both institutes.
zh: b) 某些教学科目的课程由两所学校的学生共同听受。

en: The subjects of instruction which both institutes have in common are history, geography, mathematics and physiography, the philosophical preparatory sciences, national literature, French.
zh: 两所学校共同开设、并彼此共有的教学科目是：历史、地理、数学与自然志、哲学预备学科、祖国文学以及法语。

en: With regard to history, geography and also national literature it is immediately obvious that these subjects, taught alongside the study of the ancient languages, can be presented differently and must be treated differently than in an institute in which this study is not connected with them.

In that school the study of history and geography is supported by the reading of the old historians and has a relation to it; some things can therefore be treated briefly, others must be treated more exhaustively; one can presuppose a quantity of knowledge in doing so. - The same is the case with German literature; in the gymnasium the pupil is already familiar with poetry, metre and the like, in short with a quantity of representations necessary for this.
zh: 就历史、地理以及祖国文学而言，立即可以看出：这些科目在古语言的学习之外并行教授时，其讲授方式可以是不同的，其处理方式也必须不同于那些不与古语言学习相联结的学校中的做法。
在那种学校里，历史与地理的研究因阅读古代史学家的著作而得到助益，并且与之相关；因此有些内容可以简略处理，另一些则必须详尽处理；而且在讲述时可以预设学生已经具备大量知识。——德国文学的情形也是一样；在文科中学里，学生已经熟悉诗歌、韵律以及诸如此类的东西，总之已经熟悉一大堆为处理此事所必需的表象。

en: Mathematics and physiography are not treated in a gymnasium institution to the extent which they are to receive in a real institute, nor with the direct regard to technical purposes which have to come into play in the latter. - The mathematical study further requires more than others that the teacher sees the individual in each particular subject, calls on him individually and examines him, helps those who want to fall behind in and after - which constitutes the difference of the gymnasium instruction from the university instruction.

The experience is therefore frequently that whoever has not already been introduced into mathematics at the gymnasium learns nothing more at the university, where the teacher only gives lectures and cannot look into what the individual takes in and does there, who is treated as a hearer and no longer as a pupil. - This looking into, urging on and helping, however, is only possible with a certain number of pupils; if they exceed a certain number, it must either for the most part fall away and many [must] be left entirely behind, since whoever gets stuck at one point in this science no longer keeps up with the rest, or else it holds on too long and makes those who are progressing impatient and weary of it.
Without mentioning the outward obstacle that with a large number they have to be gathered round the blackboard on which the writing is done, etc.
zh: 数学与自然志在文科中学中并不是以它们在实科学校中应当获得的那种广度来处理的，也不是从后者中必须起作用的技术性目的这一直接着眼点出发的。——数学的学习比其他学科更要求教师在每一门具体科目中都看到每个学生，个别地提问他们、考查他们，并对那些想要落后的人加以帮助和辅导——这正是文科中学教学与大学教学的区别所在。

因此经验常常是：凡是在文科中学尚未被引入数学的人，在大学里通常就再也学不到什么，因为那里的教师只作讲授，无法查看每个人从中领会和做了些什么，学生只是被当作听者，而不再被当作学生。——然而这种查看、督促和辅导只有在学生数目不多时才可能做到；如果他们超过了一定的数目，那么这种做法要么大部分取消，许多人就完全被丢下——因为在这门学问上卡在一点的人就再也跟不上其余的人了——要么它拖得太久，使那些正在前进的人变得不耐烦和厌倦。
这里且不撇开人数众多时得把大家召集到写字的黑板前等等这类外在障碍不谈。

en: The French language too is to be pursued with more extent in a real institute, and the same applies to this instruction as has just been said of mathematics, that a large number here is very obstructive to progress; furthermore that those who continue the study of the ancient languages alongside have great advantages in every respect.
zh: 法语在实科学校中同样应当以更大的广度来教授；对这一教学，也适用刚才就数学所说的话：学生人数众多在这里对推进是很大的妨碍；此外，那些同时继续研习古语言的人，在各方面都大有优势。

en: With the philosophical preparatory sciences it must be felt most strongly that they can be treated quite differently with pupils who receive a higher formation, whose capacity for comprehension has been sharpened by familiarity with classical literature and who have been introduced into a quantity of concepts of spiritual relations.

This influence however extends in general to all subjects of instruction; a difference is already founded in itself thereby, but still more by the fact that, as mentioned above, generally partly only men of little talent and capacity for comprehension, partly others out of laziness and fear of spiritual exertion, either withdraw themselves from the gymnasium studies or are transferred by the rectorate to the real institute.

This lies so very in the nature of the case, of the different material which constitutes the particular element of each of the two institutes, that the public has already grasped this, and the parents who see their sons make little progress in the gymnasium studies conclude from it that they have little aptitude for study, and therefore look about for the real institute for them after the unsuccessful attempt at the gymnasium studies.

Such pupils who have gone over there could not - or, in the case of joint instruction of both institutions, would not - keep up in the spiritual subjects with the remaining gymnasium pupils, whereas they have good aptitudes for mathematics, physics, chemistry, natural history - sciences which do not require a proper thinking and, what is still more essential, no particular depth of mind, as classical study does - and then for technical knowledge and skills, for the real in general, and can become very useful therein.

So little regard would therefore be had to them in joint instruction with the gymnasium pupils, and they would be present more only as spectators, or else these would have to be left out, whereby then neither of the two would learn anything.
zh: 在哲学预备学科上，人们最强烈地会感到：它们完全可以以一种不同的方式来对待那些接受着更高教养的 学生——这些学生的承受力已因对古典文学的熟悉而变得敏锐，并已被引入大量关于精神关系的概念。
但这种影响总体上延及所有教学科目；仅凭这一点就已经会产生一种区别本身，而更多是由于如下事实：如上文所指出，一般说来，一部分只是出于才能低下和承受力不足的人，另一部分出于惰性和对精神劳作的畏惧，要么自行退出文科中学的学习，要么被校务委员会转入实科学校。
这极其合乎事理，因为构成两所学校各自特殊成分的材料不同；公众已经抓住了这一点，而那些看到儿子们在文科中学的学习中进展甚微的父母，便由此断定他们的儿子缺乏学习的禀赋，因而在文科中学学习的尝试失败之后，转而为他们打听实科学校。
这样转入过去的学生过去——或在两所学校共同授课的情况下将会——不能在精神性的教学科目上与其余文科中学学生一同前进；相反，他们对数学、物理、化学、自然史——这些并不要求真正的思维，而且更本质地说，不要求像古典研究那样的心灵特殊深度的学问——以及随后对技术知识和技能、对一般的实在之物，倒是有很好的禀赋，并且能够在那里变得很有用。
因此，在与文科中学学生共同授课时，对他们就几乎不必顾及，他们多半只是作为旁观者在场；否则就得放弃这些课程，那样一来双方都学不到什么。

en: Since a gymnasium institution is to be regarded as a special school of preparation for higher scientific and spiritual formation, it acquires a tone of its own for all its subjects of instruction; this unity of tone, which is essential to a whole and can form only in a closed institution working towards one purpose, would be disturbed and crowded out only by a mixing of its pupils with others who do not receive the rest of the formation of the whole, and still more insofar as they are not capable of it. - A special school of that important destination well deserves to have both its own teachers and its own pupils, so that the former may devote themselves exclusively to the purpose of their pupils, and that the latter may be of one kind, one formation and one destination, and must not be neglected because of others of heterogeneous purposes and lesser abilities.

If such a combination is possible with regard to the elementary knowledge, as it indeed is found in the primary schools, where the instruction also includes the trial period of the talent, then in a higher institution, on the other hand, that separation must lie at the foundation which demands a different manner of instruction for the head capable of spiritual occupation than for the one who is not destined by nature for the intellectual, but only for the sciences which have a sensuous element, such as mathematics, physics, natural history, and for technical skill.

For them an identical instruction will take place as little (or the same instruction will be so unequal for them) as a peasant and a man who has studied can hardly drill militarily together. - A higher institution which were to suffice for both, whether in detail or in the whole, would suffice for neither of them.
zh: 由于文科中学应被视为准备接受更高学术与精神教养的一所专门学校，它便为其所有教学科目获得了一种自己的语调；这种对一个整体而言是本质性的、并且只能在一所封闭的、为一个目的而运作的学校中形成的语调统一，只会因它的学生与其他——那些并未得到整体其余部分教养的人——的混杂而受到扰乱和排挤，尤其是当他们无力承受这份教养时。——这样一所负如此重要使命的专门学校，完全应当既有自己的教师也有自己的学生，以便前者能够专门献身于自己学生的目的，而后者是同一种类、同一种教养和同一志向的人，不至于因为那些目的不同、能力较弱的其他人而被耽误。
如果就基础知识而言这种结合是可能的——在初级学校中它确实如此，那里的教学同时包含着对才能的考验期——那么在一所更高的学校里，毋宁说必须以那种区分为基础：它要求那能够从事精神活动的头脑，与那按其天性并非被指定去从事智性的、而只被指定去从事那些具有感性成分的科学（如数学、物理学、自然史）以及技术技能的人，接受各自不同的教学方式。
为他们施行同样的教学，正如一个农夫和一个受过学问训练的人几乎不可能在一起进行军事操练一样，是同样不可能的（或者同一套教学对他们而言会同样地不合适）。——一所要在个别方面或整体方面都能满足双方的高等学校，对两者中的任何一个都不会满足。

en: This separation is equally important with regard to discipline; well-mannered conduct and obedience can become the tone in an institution only if all its pupils stand under one authority in everything, have the same purpose, and all subjects of instruction are equally important for their determination or at least are necessary for them on that account, because they are pupils of this institution, in short if all the pupils stand in the same relations of instruction.

Thus, for example, pupils who belong to separate institutions will readily have at hand the excuse for laziness, capriciousness etc. in the case of negligence in handing in their work, namely that they had necessarily been working for the lessons of the other institution; they will be more lax in attention, conduct etc. in the lessons which do not belong to their own proper institution.

Positive laws on this matter and formal arrangements for removing this inconvenience, moreover that they would increase the already abundant prolixity of formalities and bring more complications into the relations, are of little efficacy if that difference lies in the nature of the case and the arrangement of the principal thing.

In any case young people readily create oppositions out of small differences already, and still more out of the ones indicated, which only refrain from degenerating into outbreaks and disagreements if these different pupils remain far apart from one another and external contact is prevented.
zh: 这种区分在纪律方面同样重要；只有当一所学校的所有学生在一切方面都服从同一个权威、抱有同一个目的、所有教学科目对他的志向都同样重要、或者至少正因为他是这所学校的学生而对他是必要的，简言之，只有当所有学生都处在同样的教学关系之中时，得体的举止与顺从才能成为一种语调。
例如，属于不同学校的学生在交作业时若有懈怠，便很容易拿出「我非得为另一所学校的课程用功」这样的借口，来搪塞懒惰、怪癖等等；在那些不属于自己所属学校的课程上，他们在专注、举止等等方面都会更加随便。
关于此事的成文法规以及旨在消除这一弊端的正式规定——何况它们还会增加本已够繁复的形式手续的冗长，给各种关系带来更多纠葛——如果那个区别本就寓于事理的性质和主要制度的安排之中，那么它们的效果也就微乎其微。
况且年轻人本来就会乐意从细小的差别中制造出对立来，从上面所说的那些差别中制造对立则更甚；而这些对立之所以还没有酿成爆发和嫌隙，只是因为这些不同的学生彼此远离，外表的接触被阻止了。

en: c) The saving of teaching posts, however, results of itself if the wishes and the need of the public are satisfied with a smaller number of classes of the real institute than was originally to be established; insofar as it should indeed seem, according to what has been most humbly set out above, that with the larger number of those who want to pursue real studies, their destination would bring with it that they would only remain in a general instruction up to the 16th

year of life, and would then either, alongside the scientific preparation within this age or immediately after it, have need to pass over to the acquisition of the particular professional knowledge and to the exercise of technical skills.

After this restriction three professors would very well perhaps be sufficient; one of mathematics and physics, one of chemistry and natural history and one of history, geography, logic and morality, besides the special teachers of the newer languages, of drawing and of calligraphy.

It would remain open, according to the individuality of the teachers, to combine those sciences differently, to lay the physics also on the teacher of chemistry, the logic and morality etc. on the teacher of natural history.

Two classes would require for the instruction which the professors have to give between 40 and 45 hours weekly, which could be all the more easily given by three individuals if the instruction in the newer languages is extended more; there would then still be time left for them to hold individual useful lectures for a more general public and for those who have already entered upon a particular destination.
zh: c) 但如果公众的愿望与需要能够以比原计划设立的更少的班级数在实科学校中得到满足，那么教师职位的节省就自然随之而来；因为据上文恭呈的说明看来，似乎在那些想修读实科课程的人为数较多的情况下，他们的志向会带来这样一点：他们只须在一般教学中止步到 16
岁，然后要么在这个年龄之内、要么紧接着这之后，便须转去获取本行那些专门的业务学问，并且去练习各项技术上的技能与本领。
在这一限制之下，三位教授或许就完全足够了：一位教数学与物理，一位教化学与自然史，一位教历史、地理、逻辑和道德学说，此外还有近代语言、绘画和书法的专任教师。
至于按照各教师的个别情况把那些学科作不同的组合——例如让化学教师兼教物理、让自然史教师兼教逻辑和道德学说等等——则仍是悬而未决的。
两个班若要开设教授们所应承担的课程，每周需要 40 到 45 课时；如果近代语言的教学再有所扩充，这 40 到 45 课时由三个人来教就会更加容易；这样他们还会剩下时间，为更广泛的公众以及为那些已经开始某种专门志向的人开设若干有用的公开讲授。

en: "Whether a different relation of the real institute to the school of study than that determined by the general ordinance can be established".
zh: 「是否可以使实科学校与中学之间的关系不同于一般规章所确定的那种关系。」

en: This nearer question can indeed only be answered from what the contemplation and experience of the preparatory relation of the Realschule to the institute yields, an experience which the undersigned
rectorate naturally lacks.

Insofar as the Realschule is on the one hand a preparatory school for the institute, and on the other hand an advanced citizens' school for such trades which demand more formation than proper craftsmen, as there are many of them here, it cannot fail that it is not very much frequented here, when elsewhere, as the student catalogues that have come in make evident, it did not seem to have found the expected access, especially since here the general elementary schools are still in their old, inadequate condition.

But with this there may enter the danger that the pupils, on account of their number and on account of the scanty preparation which they bring from the elementary schools, out of which many come in immediately without having gone through the primary schools, may not receive the proper preparation for the institute; not the preparation which the pupils of the Progymnasium would bring with them if they passed over into the institute.

If therefore perhaps this were made a condition that the attendance of the Progymnasium must precede entry into the institute, then the Realschule here, so beneficent as it is, would on the one hand quite cease to exist, while on the other hand the Progymnasium would be diminished in its important destination of preparing for the gymnasium, and it would receive the pupils from it all the more imperfectly, in proportion as heterogeneous and more extensive purposes were mixed into it.

But it is probably not so much a lack of preparation if those wishing to enter the real institute lack the proper capability, as, as mentioned above, a lack of talents, which no amount of preparation can remove to the extent of having higher scientific purposes with them, such as the determinations cited bring with them.

But insofar as in the real institute the subjects of instruction are to be conceived and presented according to higher scientific views, it then has the character of a Lyceum or a university, and the preparation to be obtained in the Realschule or in the Progymnasium would always be insufficient; the gap which the gymnasium fills in the graduated formation would still remain, - the gap of the peculiar formation of reason and taste through classical literature, with which at the same time half the time of instruction is spent on history, geography, mathematics, the philosophical preparatory sciences, which the four years of study taken together first make a thorough preparation for a Lyceum or the university.
zh: 这个更切近的问题，看来只能由对实科中学与本校之间那种预备关系的观照与经验来回答——这种经验是下署的
校务委员会自然不具备的。
就实科中学一方面是本校的预科学校，另一方面又是为那些比真正的手工匠要求更多教养的手工业行当而设的一所提高了的市民中学（这里这样的行当有很多）而言，那么它在这里不很受欢迎是必然的——何况在别处，从所收到的学生名录来看，它似乎并未取得预期的生源，尤其是因为这里的一般公立小学还处在它们旧的、不充分的状态之中。
但由此也可能出现这样的危险：由于学生人数众多，又由于他们从公立小学带来的准备不足——许多人连初级学校都没有经过就直接进来——他们可能得不到进入本校所应有的准备；得不到预科中学的学生若转入本校时所带来的那种准备。
因此，如果把这定为条件——即进入本校之前必须先就读预科中学——那么在这里如此有益的实科中学一方面就会完全停办，另一方面预科中学为文科中学作准备这一重要使命也会被削弱，而它从实科中学所得的学生也会因异质的、更为扩大的目的被掺入其中而变得更为不完善。
然而，那些想要进入实科学校的人如果欠缺应有的能力，这大概与其说是准备不足，倒不如说是——如上文所提到的——才能的欠缺；再多的准备也不能把它消除到足以使他们带有那些上述专业所要求的那种更高的学术目的。
不过，如果在实科学校中，各教学科目都要按照更高的学术观点来理解并讲授，那么它就具有高级中学或大学的样子，而在实科中学或预科中学中所应获得的那份准备就永远是不够的；文科中学在逐级教养中所填上的那个空缺仍然会存在——那正是通过古典文学所进行的特有的理性与趣味的教养所造成的空缺，而其中一半的授课时间又要用于历史、地理、数学、哲学预备学科；这四年的学习合在一起，才第一次构成对高级中学或大学的充分准备。

en: The third question, "what demands of preliminary knowledge are to be made of the pupils as a condition of admission into the institute, if this is to be capable of answering its purpose of a scientific grounding of practical knowledge with the expected success", - is in part already answered in the foregoing, in part likewise so special that it seems to be able to be answered practically more from the contemplation of the matter than from general reasons, and therefore only the rectorate of the real institute will be able to give more precise information.
zh: 第三个问题——「为了使本校能够按照其宗旨、以预期的成效来为实践知识提供科学的根据，对学生作为录取条件应当提出哪些预备知识方面的要求」——有一部分已在前文得到回答，另一部分同样如此地专门，以致它似乎只能更多地从对这一事务的观照、而不是从一般理由出发来作出实际的回答；因此只有实科学校的校务委员会才能给出更确切的说明。

en: Those entering from the primary school already bring with them from arithmetic the practical skill in the four operations with whole and fractional numbers, in proportions and in the problems founded on them; thus in the two-year course of the Realschule arithmetic can have been carried on in a more comprehensive extent, together with the elements of letter calculation and, of geometry, the mechanical drawing of figures, also planimetry.

Further the pupils can have become fairly familiar with geography to a considerable extent, and with universal history to some degree; further in natural history and cosmography with those considerable knowledge which can be given without scientific treatment.

They must also possess the ability to write orthographically, that is, not to compose treatises, but yet to recount lighter narratives and so on in writing and orally; etc. Equipped with this knowledge and the first elements in French, they will have the full capacity that the demanded scientific grounding of practical knowledge now begins with them; namely the learning of algebra, geometry, trigonometry, of systematic natural history according to the scientific divisions, physics, later chemistry and applied mathematics, together with logic and morality, whereby history, and also geography, are further continued.

Two courses, in four semesters, seem thereby to be able to give them that grounding which is necessary for their practical destination, so as to be capable of passing over from there into special schools.
zh: 从初级学校进入实科中学的学生，在算术方面已经带来了对整数与分数的四则运算、比例以及以之为基础的应用题的实际熟练；因此在实科中学的两年课程中，算术可以以更大的广度连同字母运算的要素、以及几何学中图形的技术性描绘（还有平面几何）一起进行。
此外，学生在地理方面已在相当广的范围内、在通史方面也在一定程度上有了较切的了解；此外在自然史和宇宙学方面，也已获得那些不经科学处理所能给予的大量知识。
他们还必须具备按正确拼写书写的能力——并不是要撰写论文，而是能书面或口头复述较轻的叙述等等；诸如此类。具备了这些知识和法语的初步基础，他们将完全有能力做到：人们所要求的、以为实践知识提供科学的根据这件事，从他们身上开始；也就是学习代数、几何学、三角学、按科学门类编排的系统自然史、物理学，随后是化学和应用数学，并连同逻辑学与道德学说，其中历史、还有地理则继续进行。
两门课程、四个学期，似乎由此就能给予他们那种为其实际志向所必需的科学根据，使他们从那里起便有能力转入专门学校。

en: In that with this the undersigned
rectorate has been able to answer the questions submitted by the highest, only insofar as they enter into its range of vision, the same remains in the deepest reverence.
zh: 下署的校务委员会至此仅就那些进入其视野的最高所提交的问题
就那些至高的当局所提交的那些问题作出了答复，并且仍怀着最深的敬意。
